(BY SRI. M R PATIL, HCGP FOR R-1;
 SRI. A K SRIHARSHA, ADVOCATE FOR R-2)
 THIS CRIMINAL PETITION IS FILED UNDER SECTION 482 OF  THE CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE, 1973 PRAYING TO QUASH THE  -2-  NC: 2023:KHC:33787  CRL.P No. 8859 of 2023 FIR AND FINAL REPORT/CHARGE SHEET REGISTERED BY THE RESPONDENT POLICE IN C.C.NO.7755/2017 (CRIME NO.18/2016)
(0445/2016) FOR THE ALLEGED OFFENCES P/U/S 498A,506 OF IPC AND SECTION 3 AND 4 OF D.P.ACT, PENDING BEFORE THE LEARNED II ADDITIONAL CMM, COURT, BENGALURU.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR REPORTING SETTLEMENT,
THIS DAY, THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER Petitioner-accused No.1 is sought to be prosecuted for the offence punishable under Sections 498A,
506 of IPC, and Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
2.

The case of the prosecution is that, the petitioner- accused is the husband and he subjected the defacto- complainant to cruelty, both mentally and physically, and also a demand was made to bring money from the parental home.

3. The parties are present before this Court and have filed a joint affidavit stating that, they amicably resolved the dispute among themselves, and in terms of the settlement, the defacto complainant has reunited with her husband and leading a cordial marital life and further she has no objection for quashing the impugned proceedings against the petitioner.
4. The joint affidavit is placed on record.

5. Though the offences alleged against the petitioner is cognizable and non-compoundable, however,
having regard to the fact that, the parties have amicably resolved the disputed among themselves,
and the defacto-complainant NC: 2023:KHC:33787 having no objections for quashing the impugned proceedings, it would be a futile exercise, if the petitioner is subjected to trial, since the probability of his conviction is remote and bleak in view of the settlement.

Therefore, the continuation of the Sri. Chidanandan. V vs The State Of Karnataka By on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/152368672/
2

5. Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The Criminal Petition is allowed;
ii) The impugned proceedings in C.C. No.7755/2017 on the file of the Learned II Additional Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Bengaluru is hereby quashed.
Sd/-
JUDGE HR Sri. Chidanandan.
